name: GA-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Hank Johnson running for reelection
Republican challenger has minimal reported fundraising
model.rationale: The D+27 lean, a well-established incumbent seeking another term, and prediction markets pricing Johnson near 98% all point to a safe Democratic hold. The Republican challenger shows no meaningful fundraising or outside support to suggest an upset.
model.watch: A major late outside-spending intervention or an unexpected incumbent scandal would be the only plausible route to making this competitive.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Georgia's 4th District is a heavily Democratic Atlanta-area seat with a 27-point Democratic partisan lean. Hank Johnson, the longtime incumbent, is running for reelection and has raised over $400,000 for the cycle. His Republican opponent, James Duffie, reports no significant fundraising and has no outside spending on either side.

Prediction markets give Johnson roughly a 98% chance of winning, and no expert raters flag the race as competitive. With no public polling available, the forecast rests on the district's strong partisan fundamentals, which comfortably favor the incumbent party. The seat is expected to remain safely Democratic in November.
